title: Step 58-C application shell routing RTL and i18n
description: Implement only the replaceable storefront application shell, canonical route placeholders, Persian fa-IR/RTL root semantics, minimal i18n architecture, exact Step54 design-token bridge, responsive/accessibility shell primitives and deterministic SSR shell verification. Do not implement Stage D API/data, Stage E auth/session, customer feature logic, Admin frontend or Step 59.

dependencies.name: Stage 58-B frontend workspace and build foundation

acceptance_criteria.description: Root document is Persian-first fa-IR and real RTL, and shell uses logical CSS direction rather than physical left/right layout assumptions.

Global shell contains skip link, header, search/cart/account reachability, accessible compact navigation disclosure, contextual breadcrumb, exactly one main region and footer without inventing customer business behavior.
All actual slash-prefixed Step55 storefront route intents are registered as future-feature placeholders only; design state intents are not invented as routes.
App design tokens are an exact bridge from the generated Step54 canonical token source, with no Brown palette or independent token authority.

Shell preserves 320/360/600/840/1200/1440 verification widths, 1280 content maximum, 44px target baseline, visible focus and reduced-motion support; SSR smoke verification passes all registered route examples.
No API client/auth/session/business authority/backend mutation/Admin frontend/Step59 feature implementation enters Stage C.
Canonical closure requires exact-head verify/phase-a/merge-policy, artifact-bound REVIEW/LOCK, protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification before Stage D can start.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage C is MEDIUM risk. Stage D and Step59 remain forbidden until protected transport and exact-SHA postmerge verification are green.
